# The skips the browser suite held when this ratchet landed (10.10.2026).
#
# One line each: "<file>:<line><tab><call as written, on one line>". The line
# number is informational; the call text is what gets matched, so an edit above
# a skip does not invalidate its entry.
#
# This list may only shrink. A skip comes off it by saying which kind of skip it
# is, the way the Go suite does:
#
#   test.skip(cond, 'FLOTESTRO-SKIP class=absent reason="..."')
#   test.skip(cond, `FLOTESTRO-SKIP class=not_applicable runs_on=agent-arch reason="..."`)
#
# Most of these fire only on a token that cannot read something, and the gate
# runs with a token that can read everything - so they are quiet in the gate
# and would be a fatal run the day they are not. That is the point of writing
# them down: nothing new joins them.
